Definition 0.4 (Balanced weighting). A weighting \(w\) is balanced if \(\bd w = 0\), and the balanced weightings form the sublattice

\begin{equation}\label {eq:cycle-lattice} \Zcyc (\quiv ) \;=\; \ker \bd \;\subseteq \; W(\quiv ), \end{equation}
which we call the cycle lattice of \(\quiv \). The quotient \(W(\quiv )/\Zcyc (\quiv )\) is the boundary lattice of \(\quiv \).
